content: Procreate Brush Studio: Stabilization group = StreamLine (Amount, Pressure), Stabilization (moving average, speed-dependent), Motion Filtering (tremor). Apple Pencil group = pressure graph (size/opacity/flow/bleed), tilt, barrel roll. Dynamics = speed->size/opacity/spacing, jitter. Wet Mix, Grain, Shape, Taper, Rendering modes. Global pressure curve in Preferences. Time-lapse is a 30fps VIDEO recording (1080p-4K), replay scrubbable but not state-based; settings fixed at canvas creation. Official handbook.
